name: Electronic Manufacturing Co
about:
Electronic Manufacturing Co is based in Maplewood, New Jersey.

The company specializes in precision metal components for vacuum tubes, electron tubes, and opto-electronic devices. It describes itself as an industry leader in precision metal components for vacuum tubes and electron tubes. Its manufacturing capabilities center on CNC milling, supported by a dedicated CNC milling center. The product range includes vacuum and electron tube parts as well as opto-electronic parts.

Electronic Manufacturing Co serves manufacturers in the vacuum tube, electron tube, and opto-electronic industries. The firm holds ITAR registration and RoHS compliance, indicating involvement with defense-related and environmentally regulated products.

The company states that quality parts and on-time delivery are what set it apart from competitors.
